# mockingbird

> A video editing engine for AI agents, on macOS (Apple Silicon). An agent such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Gemini CLI connects over MCP (`mockingbird mcp`) and gets tools to transcribe footage with word times, take stills, make word-by-word captions, cut and frame clips, draw motion graphics as code, and render, all on the user's computer. Free, open source (MIT), no account; the only network use is the user-run model download.

To install it or set it up for someone, follow the agent setup guide. It lists the steps, how to check each one, and how to register the MCP server.

## Docs

- [Set up with a coding agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NirjharBhattacharjee/mockingbird/main/docs/AGENT_INSTALL.md): install, check, connect over MCP, written for agents
- [Tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NirjharBhattacharjee/mockingbird/main/docs/MCP.md): every MCP tool and its options
- [User guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NirjharBhattacharjee/mockingbird/main/docs/README.md): commands, troubleshooting, privacy
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NirjharBhattacharjee/mockingbird/main/README.md): what it is, install
